text: Experts have different opinions about the future of AI. Today, we use "narrow AI" for specific tasks like translation or driving. However, many companies are now trying to build Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) – a machine that can think and learn like a human. This technology could bring amazing benefits, such as solving diseases or climate change. At the same time, there are serious risks. AGI might become difficult to control or could take millions of jobs. Some experts predict we will see AGI within twenty years; others believe it is much further away. Nobody knows for sure, but one thing is clear: the choices we make today will shape our future with AI.
